groups.basis: Both facts describe the same offer from beat_10. Lady Hilda, a seasoned, armored fighter, will join the dragon hunt if the party pays her. Both serve thread_2 with the same form and certainty. fact_12 is the home representation in thread_4.
groups.text: Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter in chain mail and shield, would join the party's dragon hunt for pay. Her fee is not yet set.
